scope: Read-only source investigation plus bash -n and Python AST parse. No Cargo/Rust compilation, Docker start, Matrix login, live account access or messaging. No production or workflow implementation was changed.
conclusion: Existing exact runner is a Mac/Xcode qualification in both shell and Rust validation, and cannot honestly run unchanged on a normal Linux runner. A real Mac with usable Docker can reuse it unchanged; a strict Linux sibling requires explicit Linux host evidence and validation while preserving the original Mac schema8 checks and every shared product-behavior assertion. Merely adding a Linux shell, using diagnostic mode, or fabricating Apple fields is invalid.

current_entry.source_mode: exact rejects dirty, untracked AND ignored entries; Rust rechecks Git HEAD/tree/status and source hashes. diagnostic permits dirty source but runner-evidence exact_candidate_evidence=false and cannot close the exact gate. Both modes keep promotion/operator_acceptance false.

current_entry.execution: Runs the Cargo-identified test executable with the exact test name, --exact --test-threads=1 --nocapture. This existing fixture executes its bound binary directly, not the ordinary just/nextest package-test path. Its completion nonce and teardown/publication checks are additional required evidence.
current_entry.supply_chain: Private env -i PATH/HOME/CARGO_HOME; native rustc release equals candidate toolchain file; exact compiler hashes. Seed only registry/cache, registry/index and bare git/db; reject seed symlinks/config, omit credentials/unpacked sources, repack/fsck local git objects. All builds locked/offline.
current_entry.resource_cost: Two independent cold targets, copied dependency seed, native toolchain and Synapse volume are required. Current workflow CARGO_PROFILE_* overrides must be absent; no implicit reuse of parent build targets or CI profiles. Capacity and timing need actual remote measurements.

hard_mac_constraints.constraint: Fixed /opt/homebrew Python and Bash>=4; closed Mac tool list; xcrun/xcode-select/Xcode compiler+SDK full ledger; BSD stat -f; atomic renamex_np(RENAME_EXCL).

schema8 deny_unknown_fields; mandatory Mac/Apple booleans; actual /opt/homebrew Python identity; actual xcrun/xcodebuild/SDKSettings/clang resource/tree revalidation; exact47 tool names including Apple tools; exact original runner path. No existing Linux host-evidence branch.

Model endpoints are bounded wiremock SSE fixtures, not external generative APIs.

minimal_linux_change_proposal.change: Add a separately named checked-in Linux entry. Preserve original Mac shell bytes. Reuse unchanged synapse-loopback-proxy.py and identical image/network/user/fault/cleanup protocol. Native Linux tool discovery, exact hashes, env allowlist, private targets and offline seed rules must be explicit.

Keep legacy Mac schema8 deserialization and all Mac checks intact. Introduce a separate versioned Linux manifest/host-validator with explicit Linux target/host binding and Linux runner-path authority. Share source/lock/toolchain/seed, executable identity, transport, nonce and common product validators. Do not use optional Apple fields or a default-true bypass.

Bind actual compiler/linker/archiver/pkg-config tools and resource/include/link inputs to a reviewed Linux sysroot manifest or immutable builder image, then independently revalidate them in Rust before execution and after teardown. A runner OS label, or arbitrary Linux paths labelled Apple, is insufficient. The concrete sysroot/image choice must be frozen before qualification.

Use actual Linux no-overwrite atomic publication such as renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE), fsync files and parent directories, reject unsupported semantics; preserve exact private file modes and inode/link checks. Do not replace Darwin renamex_np with overwrite-capable os.rename.

Keep run_real_synapse_qualification_inner, fleet/supervisor, encryption, ack-loss, restart, approval, identity and count assertions unchanged. Freeze relevant function/body hashes or a reviewed delta proving only host-evidence adaptation. A Linux pass closes only the Linux runtime path.

New Linux entry should initialize external failure evidence before compilation and retain allowlisted compiler JSON/logs, exit status and failed-stage tombstone without private credentials. Preserve verified actual executables if durable byte-level replay is required. Existing Mac success artifact-set stores executable hashes, not executable bytes.

same_candidate_execution_plan: Restore and verify the one original producer artifact in an independent disposable checkout using current exact result/source/recipe/vendor/lock checks. Keep its downloaded bytes immutable.

If Linux qualification code is new, first freeze its narrowly test-only overlay or include it in the next reviewed source/producer run. It changes full test-source identity: never claim the old artifact SHA represents a tree with an unrecorded Linux adaptation. Production paths and both sealed locks must remain byte-identical.

Create a qualification-only local commit from exactly the verified complete candidate index/tree. Record producer source commit, producer RESULT SHA, complete candidate patch SHA, qualification overlay SHA if any, new commit and full tree; do not overwrite the producer original source_commit field. No merge or production promotion is required.

Require completely empty Git status including ignored files; keep artifacts, seed, rustup and targets outside checkout. Existing verify_tree expects old HEAD and cannot silently be reused after this new commit; qualification wrapper must compare against the explicitly sealed qualification commit/tree plus original policy/source inventories.

Run cheap facility preflight first: native exactRust1.96, real local Docker capability, fixed image ID/labels/platform, loopback access, internal bridge and volume permissions, private filesystem and no-overwrite/fsync support, complete offline dependency seed, adequate disk/memory, permitted product process/signal/sandbox capabilities. Do not infer Mac Docker availability from a hosted runner label.

Run exact source mode only, retain complete command/exit/stdout/stderr from before harness startup, then verify original failure tombstone or full success completion and artifact hashes. A test body PASS alone is insufficient until runner post-cleanup provenance/publication succeeds.
Bind returned receipts to the qualification commit/tree, source patch/lock/vendor identities, real executable hashes and requested platform; preserve all pending cross-platform/deny/normal-CI gates.
remaining_obstacles: No suitable Mac+Docker qualification host is established by the inspected source or current Ubuntu workflow.
A strict Linux host-evidence schema/validator/entry does not currently exist and requires implementation/review before the original body can run honestly on Linux.
Exact fixed Synapse config image architecture compatibility and materialization on the chosen Linux runner are unverified.
Actual SDK0.19.1 compilation of real_synapse_e2e.rs is unverified; Matrix port owner confirmed only bounded source migration, not this full test API compilation.
Full dependency seed and native build/runtime facility requirements must be met without broadening source/feature budgets.

Original Mac early failures remove private build state before artifact staging; later failure quarantines may contain only FAILURE.json. External console capture is necessary and is not a substitute for missing compiler JSON.
Linux qualification cannot close Mac/Windows compile or applicable platform regressions, original Mac exact qualification, unchanged cargo-deny or operator approval.
